_brief: Item 12, Phone Call Video / Tel Aviv. Single-person video: the woman in the grey dress (IMG_5724, English). V3 after Tal's note on V2 (2026-10-03): 'zoom out a bit so you can see the sign what makes you happy. Or put the video of me dropping the thing and then her speaking.' Both done: it opens on Tal setting the stand with the sign and the red phone down in the street (IMG_5688), then her lines, and she is framed at a static 1.3x (was 1.8x) so the whole sign is readable under her. Captions sit above the sign (capY 0.53). NO ZOOMS: constant framing per take.

EK_HAPPY_TELAVIV_LOOKUP_V4.mp4 = the _BUILD render + blur-face.py with blur-rules.json: two boys who walk toward the camera behind her in the last beat.
